title: Optional local UI preview
text: Create the local render-proof connection with `yoke dev setup <checkout> --admin-env render-proof --with-test-postgres --dry-run`; review the plan, then replace --dry-run with --yes. An agent changing UI can optionally preview the lane before merge with `yoke dev run -- env YOKE_ENV=render-proof python3 -m runtime.api.tools.serve_workbench_for_review`. That server uses a disposable local universe and refuses prod and remote connections. It is a self-check, never a merge or QA requirement. Formal Browser QA runs post-deploy on production.
